inicio.kicker: Selling with AI Program · course 2 of 5 · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: Consulting Playbook: sell diagnosis, not building
inicio.lead: Building got easy. Trusting what was built did not. In eight lessons you learn to run the discovery call, measure before you propose, build a stepped pricing ladder, review your own call, talk to an executive, and open doors with free office hours and a workshop.
inicio.capa_alt: A consultant listens to the owner of a small business at a meeting table, with an open notebook and a closed laptop.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order of a consulting job: position, discover, propose, review, communicate, decide the technology, attract and teach.

itens: Consultants, freelancers, agencies or technical professionals who want to sell AI to companies.
People who already deliver projects but feel they compete only on price.
People who want to sell diagnosis, monthly advisory and teaching, not just "I'll build your agent."

blocos.t: What you walk away able to do
itens: Say in two lines what you do and what you don't do.
Run the discovery call with the 3 questions and hit the brakes when red flags show up.
Send a one-page proposal with a baseline in numbers and 3 options.
Score your own call, write the report for an executive and run a 1-hour workshop.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in Professional 2030
itens: Professional 2030 has four roles: Consultant, Auditor, Mentor and Trainer. All four sell trust, not building.
This course trains the Consultant: diagnosis, adoption plan, proposal and measured result. Lessons 7 and 8 bring the Trainer's workshop.
The common base it uses: AI without exaggeration, scope with written authorization and the one-page report for executives.
